prompt: Vertical 9:16 night photograph on cheap colour negative film, standing at the front of a narrow British corner-shop aisle and looking straight down it. Only the front tube is still on; each one after is off, so the aisle fades step by step into near-black at the back, where the stockroom door stands open a hand's width. Crisps and tins on cluttered shelves, unbranded. On the floor halfway down, a single loaf of white sliced bread lies dropped, a price sticker reading "£5". Cold teal fluorescent cast, blown highlights, thick grain, soft focus, slightly crooked framing. Empty of people, but the dark end feels occupied. No digital sheen. Thanks.
